items.title: Capital One Financial (COF) Completes €750 Million Twin Euro Bond Offerings
items.summary: Capital One Financial (NYSE:COF) has completed two euro-denominated bond offerings, each with a principal amount of €750 million. The new fixed to floating rate notes are scheduled to mature in 2032 and 2037, and extend the group's euro funding profile. Both Eurobond tranches add to Capital One Financial's presence in European fixed income markets and broaden its investor base. items.title: The Forgotten Generation Is Broke: 50% of All New Bankruptcies Are 40-59 Year Olds
items.summary: Something unusual is happening inside America's bankruptcy courts, and it has nothing to do with reckless young borrowers drowning in student loans. The age group that should be approaching its financial peak is quietly becoming the face of collapse, and banks are starting to feel it.
